thread:
Sam (sales-eng): Quick sync before POC with CedarBank tomorrow. They require SSO-only access (no static keys), SCIM group sync, and an ephemeral service account for CI runs. Also asking if we can split billing visibility from inference admin.
Alex (infra): We support SSO-only workspaces. We can disable static API keys at workspace level and allow only ephemeral tokens. SCIM -> role mapping is supported; include `scim_group` in the invite to auto-assign.
Priya (security): For the questionnaire: recommend encrypted SAML assertions, assertion consumer URL, group claim mapping, and optional IP allowlist for token minting. We'll also request their IdP metadata file.
Jordan (solutions): If they expect sustained concurrency >100 rps we should offer a short Dedicated trial. Otherwise hosted with ephemeral tokens is simpler. Need their sample request sizes to decide.
Mateo (acct exec): Billing separation is fine. Create `billing-view` role and scope it to billing info only. We can include this in the invite payload.
Sam (sales-eng): Can someone drop a minimal invite JSON I can share with their infra team for automation?
Alex (infra): Minimal invite payload they can POST to our SCIM endpoint:
```json
{
  "email": "ci-bot@cedarbank.com",
  "display_name": "CedarBank CI Bot",
  "roles": ["svc-inference"],
  "scim_group": "cedar-poc-ci",
  "expires_at": "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```
Priya (security): Add `billing-view` for the finance contact and `viewer` for auditors if needed. Also we'll include a checklist: disable static keys, require SSO, enable SCIM sync, IP allowlist optional, KMS recommended for Private.
onboard-bot: Onboarding link: https://console.redwood.ai/onboard/cedarbank (expires in 5 days) :link:
Sam (sales-eng): Action items: Alex - post SCIM endpoint docs to the thread; Priya - draft questionnaire response; Jordan - pricing note for Dedicated trial if they provide QPS profile; Mateo - confirm billing-role email. I'll send this payload to their infra contact now.
